title: I'll give it points for being a cute idea but...
text: I'll give it points for being a cute idea but.... it's not really an ornament as there is no way to hang it... and the dog's face is poorly painted.  It looks like someone just splashed paint on it and called it good.  For an ornament that had real potential to convey my feelings about the year 2020 this ornament did not deliver.  Really disappointed
